items.title: Harold Christophe Interview, 1961-08-01
items.q: Then later years, after he left, when Rainey come in at that store.

ctx.x: He was at that store at that time. Lee Collins was over there too. Yeah. Yeah. Then later years, after he left, when Rainey come in at that store. Rainey stayed down during the 30s and so forth.
Did Dave Jones do anything else in the day? Have any other kind of a job, or just make a living from his music? How did he do?
